overloads.semanticRole: Appends a row to a 4D Write Pro table, filling each cell from an individual variadic value argument.

discriminatedBy.note: one or more discrete scalar/object values passed positionally, one per cell

overloads.semanticRole: Appends a row to a 4D Write Pro table, filling each cell from the corresponding element of a values collection.

discriminatedBy.note: single Collection argument, one element per cell

constraints: Supported value types (both syntaxes): Text, Number, Time, Date, Picture, and Object (formula or named formula returning a row element).
Default cell alignment depends on value type: Text is left-aligned, Picture is centered, and Number/Date/Time are right-aligned.
The number of values or collection size should match the number of cells in the table row to avoid unexpected results.
